metadata.description: Short, lowercase deployment name used to build globally unique resource names.
Azure region in which the desktop support plane is deployed.
Deploy the support API after the infrastructure image has been published.
Immutable support API container image including its sha256 digest. Required when deployApi is true.
Microsoft Entra tenant-specific API authority. The common authority is not accepted.
Microsoft Entra application ID URI expected in desktop access tokens.
Application (client) ID of the reviewed desktop public client allowed in delegated access tokens.
Object ID of the Entra group that administers the Azure SQL logical server.
Display name of the Entra group that administers the Azure SQL logical server.
Legacy Azure OpenAI model name. Required only while the legacy account is retained.
Pinned legacy Azure OpenAI model version. Required only while the legacy account is retained.

Complete Microsoft Foundry project endpoint. Required shape:
https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>
It must be https on the default port, the host must end with the exact suffix
`.services.ai.azure.com`, the path must be exactly `/api/projects/<project>`
with no trailing slash, and it must carry no user info, query, or fragment.
The account host label and the account named by foundryProjectResourceId must
agree. Bicep has no regular-expression parameter constraint, so the shape is
enforced by the deployment-time assertions below.

ARM resource ID used as the Foundry role-assignment scope. Either
/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/<account>
or the narrower
.../accounts/<account>/projects/<project>. It must name the same account as
foundryProjectEndpoint.
Name of the dedicated user-assigned identity used only for Foundry model access.
App Configuration key prefix under which reviewed model profiles are published. Lowercase, colon-separated, ending with the separator, and never a wildcard.
Seconds between Foundry deployment-catalog refreshes.
Maximum age of a cached Foundry deployment catalog before the broker must fail closed. Must be at least the refresh interval.
Pilot-only escape hatch: reuse the shared runtime identity for Foundry model access instead of creating a dedicated model-broker identity. Leave false outside a reviewed pilot.

Retire the legacy fixed Azure OpenAI account and its desktop-planning deployment. Left false so that migrating an existing deployment never silently deletes the legacy account; flipping it to true removes the resource from this stack and the operator then deletes it deliberately.

Name of the EXISTING private DNS zone that already fronts the Foundry account, for example the zone reported by the operator network team. Empty means public egress or externally managed egress. This stack never creates or duplicates a Foundry zone or private endpoint.
Private endpoint group ID (subresource) of the EXISTING Foundry private endpoint, read from the operator-owned endpoint. Empty means public egress or externally managed egress.
Deployment-wide resource tags.
Canonical provider profile hash (sha256:<hex>).
Canonical model profile hash (sha256:<hex>).
Canonical model capability hash (sha256:<hex>).
Deploy scheduled-query alerts and the monthly budget.
Action group resource id for alerts; required when deployAlerts is true.
Monthly budget amount in the subscription currency.
Environment tag value used by alerting and budgets.

metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace resource id backing Application Insights.
Action group receiving every support-plane alert.
Deployment location for the alert rules.
Environment tag value (for example prod or staging).

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-authentication-spike
scheduledAlerts.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "sapphirus.support.authentication.outcomes" | where tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "denied" | summarize denied = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-consent-replays
scheduledAlerts.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "sapphirus.support.replays.observed" | summarize replays = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-receipt-signing-failures
scheduledAlerts.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "sapphirus.support.dependency.latency" | where tostring(Properties["dependency"]) == "signing" and tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "failed" | summarize failures = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-sql-saturation
scheduledAlerts.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "sapphirus.support.dependency.latency" | where tostring(Properties["dependency"]) == "sql" | summarize p95 = percentile(Sum, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where p95 > 500

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-model-throttling
scheduledAlerts.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "sapphirus.support.provider.statuses" | where tostring(Properties["provider_status_class"]) == "429" | summarize throttles = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-privacy-canary
scheduledAlerts.description: A privacy canary marker reached exported telemetry. Sev 0: engage the incident procedure.
scheduledAlerts.query: union AppTraces, AppExceptions, AppRequests, AppDependencies | where tostring(Properties) contains "CANARY_" or Message contains "CANARY_" | summarize hits = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

scheduledAlerts.name: desktop-support-slo-burn
scheduledAlerts.description: Availability SLO fast burn: server failure ratio over 5 minutes.
scheduledAlerts.query: AppRequests | summarize total = count(), failed = countif(ResultCode startswith "5") by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where total > 0 | extend ratio = todouble(failed) / todouble(total) | where ratio > 0.05
